You have not enough points for the highscore!
I remember it as if it were yesterday.
I had just bought a new yacht, and I was eager to take it for a ride... So I took it out to sea.
In my excitement, I didn't really pay attention to where I was going, and I got into a storm.
The storm... drove me off course.
All of a sudden, a bolt of lightning struck the boat... and caused a fire.
The fire spread so quickly I couldn't do anything to stop it, and soon it reached the fuel cans...
...and it caused an explosion that shattered my boat into a thousand pieces.
And it threw me off board... drifting.
An island! This is what I call good luck. The sea has washed me ashore practically unharmed.
I should take a look around.
On the left top you can see four bars that represent your present state:
You must keep an eye on hunger, thirst and tiredness. They may not rise too high. If one of these bars is full, you start to lose health. If nothing is left of your health bar, you die.
For a closer look at your state, you can look it up under "character" in the menu or press [$key_char].
You can attack with [$key_attack1]. Attack objects to damage them or to get items.
Items that lay around loose can be gathered with [$key_use].
The thereby gathered items can then be used, dumped, combined or taken in the hand in the inventory [$key_items].
A part of the provisions that you had aboard has stranded here, too. But it is enclosed in crates and barrels. Use [$key_attack1] to destroy those and [$key_use] to collect the laid open items!
You are still feeling dizzy. That is why everything is blurry, but this will go over.
It quite looks like I cannot find a hotel to simply check in.
So I will have to take care of my situation on myself and build a shelter to sleep under. But first things first: I don't even have the right tools for that yet...

Items can be combined in the inventory [$key_items] to get new kinds of items. Choose at least two items by clicking them and then hit the "Combine" button with the plus symbol. If one or several combinations with the selected items is possible, a new window will open and display the combinations which are executed per left-click.
Keep in mind that you can also obtain items if you just hit, for instance, trees or stones by holding down [$key_attack].
After several failures I have now managed to connect a stone with a branch in a way that reminds of a simple hammer... with a lot of fantasy. I would prefer proper one, of course.
Anyway, the thingy should be sufficient to construct a tent or a wooden shelter.
Select the hammer in the inventory and then press [$key_attack2] and the building menu will open, wherein you can select a building and choose a location.
Press [$key_attack2] again at the building site to work on the building.
The special functions of weapons or tools are always triggered per [$key_attack2], whereas [$key_attack1] usually starts an attack.

It is recommandable to begin with a shelter. A tent may on the one hand be handier because it can be packed and set up again elsewhere - but on the other hand, you must hunt animals first to make the required tent kit by combining their hides with sticks in the inventory!
There by the way is no need to carry all required materials when you set up a building site. You can gather and employ them later just as well.
Finally, a shelter above my head... at least symbolically.

So, from now on  I will not have to sleep under open sky anymore and should be protected at least a bit from bad weather, coldness and predators. Although I am still rather sceptical if the latter will be very impressed by a simple pile of sticks and leaves.

I should definitely be prepared to live here for quite a while. It will surely take some time until they send somebody to search for me. And even in case that somebody is on his way: I haven't got a clue how far this Island is away from my original course.
I can only hope that somebody will find me here and use the time I am waiting to make the most of what I have got here.
Constructing a new building often enables you to construct further kinds of buildings! Select the hammer and press [$key_attack2] to find out what you can build.
This campfire will give me warmth and light. But naturally, I must find a way to light it first. Since I neither have a lighter nor a box of matches at hand right now, I must find another way.
Fireplaces provide more than just light. Certain items can be processed or combined in the fire to improve their quality.

Oops! During the construction of my camp, I have found something shiny in the mud. At second sight I came to the conclusion that a picklock is what I am dealing with. With some deftness, I should be able to pick just about any lock with it. There's only one thing that tempers the delight: Which lock? I should keep my eyes open to find something to use this picklock on. Perhaps it might bring me onwards somehow.

With my digging, I discovered a pirate instead of a treasure. I believe he's quite a nut, but that shouldn't bother me at the moment. I have caught him a parrot to make him give me a lift. But now I'm also supposed to dig out gold for him. Gosh, what a slavedriver!
Hey... I have a feeling that tells me that I'll need this for something! I'll rather keep it.
I think there's something on this island that I can open hereby. I must just find it!
Something's shimmering in these rocks. It looks like iron ore! If I manage to extract some of it by force, the iron might be my chance to achieve better tools or weaponry.
Golden as the stars that shine and twinkle on the milky way,
it stretchs in never-ending line along the margin of a bay...
Well, that stuff could be bloody useful.
2. On usage in the inventory [$key_items], grains can be extracted from the bundles of crop.
3. These grains can be sowed anewedly. But they can also be eaten or processed into flour.
babble babble ... a source of fresh water! Here I can satisfy my thirst.
With [$key_use], fresh water can be drunk from the source.
Some items can only be used near fire or sources of water. Others may get an entirely different purpose there. So you should always pay attention to your environment when you use items!
These funny, smooth soft balls of wool... look suspiciously like cotton. I can surely pluck those things off and use them somehow.
By striking upon the plants [$key_attack1], you can gather wool.

There are bubbles arising in the water! That can only mean that there are many fishes at this part of the shore. If I could manage to make a fishing rod somehow, I could certainly pull them out of the water without too much effort.
Rising bubbles and circle-shapen waves at the surface are indicators for fishing areas.
Harr, harr! Whom have we got here?!
Ye stinking landlubber should better leave thine dirty fingers away from the treasures of us seamen!
Do thou not know how much work it is to steal all the plunder?
A pirate? Pirates do not exist anymore!

NO, of course ye do not! Arr! Ye art no pirate, after all... Although I must admit that ye stink like a real buccaneer! If ye fell in the seas they would surely spit ye back ashore because ye stink so much! Hohoho!
But wherefore do ye do this? Why ye be diggin' out my treasure?
I did not know it is yours!
Well, I kind of stranded here...
Oh, alright. But that makes thine deed even worse! Arr!
Why do ye just steal my treasury even though ye know for sure how mean that is?
It's not like it's written on it that it's yours.
I wanted to know what's inside.
Hohoho, what makes thee so sure?
Thou do not even know when and where this game plays! Aye?
And now that ye see a real pirate captain in front of ye, ye say that piracy would not exist anymore! That is truly foolish! Har Har Har!
This is getting too awkward for my taste!
And keep thine clutches off me treasures!
I indeed forgot to write my name on the chest! Unbelievable! Har har har!
But now that ye mention it: I cannot write at all anyway! Hohoho!
And what do ye do here, apart from thievery?
I'll better leave you alone now.
Watch out where ye poke thine nose in!
A propos nose: Did ye notice how many extremities I miss? Hohoho!
But no matter now! Har har!
Arr, why... say it again: why are ye digging me plunder out?
Harhar, hoho, bye to thee! Arrrrr!
Ye shalt not do that because it is totally mean! So mean is it, I am close to shed tears.
But it might also be just because I once again picked around in mine eye with the wrong hand!
Do not change the subject! Aye?
Speak it out! What brings ye here?
I actually am in quite a lack of transport, too, at the moment. All I have is me phantom boat. It lies on the beach down there. I have just come hither after all! Hoho!
Unfortunately, it is invisible. That makes it hard to see. Not easy to get in without getting wet! Har har har!
But let us get back to business: ye surely want to get away, don't ye?
I can offer thee a deal:
Ye must know I have come hither to get a new parrot. My shoulder is looking a bit empty.
The olde one is not among us anymore, ye know? He had a horrible accident.
He fell down from my shoulder, and I did not take notice. My wooden leg finished him off. Right onto the skull. Didn't look nice, I tell ye! Har har har!
Anyway, I would take thee with me if ye get me a parrot. Sounds great, doesn't it?
Hmm... okay! I'll do my best!
Those creatures fly around just around everywhere here. Ye should lurk until one of them lands, sneak nearer and catch it! Harhar!
But remember: I need it alive. I already have got a dead one.
Let's see what I can do.
But do not complain if I catch one on myself in the meantime and then just get off.
Without saying fayre thee well! Har har har!
So come back hither and talk to me once again if ye want to help me.
Oh, as I see ye still hast not succeeded yet, lad!

Perhaps ye should make a device if ye cannot do it with thine bare hands: Take about 10 pieces o'thread and a branch. If ye combine them deftly, ye will get a nice net. If ye use that, ye can get the creature from a farer distance, aye?
Ye have it, ye have it! Good job, young swashbuckler! Hoho!
And what a magnific specimen ye have cought! I am proud of thee.
Of course thine success is all mine because only my instructions enabled thee to prevail. Actually, I should not help thee but even ask gold from thee! Harhar!
But do not worry, I am a man of my word!
There is time left for thee to fetch thine stuff. When ye art ready, just come down to the beach. I will wait beneath the phantom boat. Harharhar.
Wilst ye catch the parrot for me? Hoho!
I will take thee off this island then. Ye will never get such an offer again!
Then get startet! I will wait here.
If ye want to get off here ye should really think about it once again.
Come again when ye have taken thine decision. But keep in mind that mine time is limited, too.
I have found the phantom boat and prepared everything for the voyage. I am ready to head for our destination. Arr!
Just tell me when ye art ready!
Wait a minute! I'd almost have forgotten that! Harrr!
It occurs to me that I have still some gold hidden on this island. 3 bags of it, spread over 3 different stashes.
Dig 'em out, too, now that ye art on it anyway. 'twould be a great shame to leave 'em here!
I'll better briskly mark it for you on this map.
Hither we go. Harr! And now onwards!

I hope ye didst not have too much problems dealing with the terrible creepy curses that laid upon the stashes. I did not mention it because I was afraid ye might refuse to dig that stuff of mine out. Hohoho!
But apparently, ye have survived! Harrr!
We can leave now as far as mine preparation goes.
What kind of curse is a grapevine supposed to be?
How many bags were it, again?
What art ye to dig it out with?
With a shovel ye shalt do so!
Take a bloody look at the bleeding map and wrench the gold from the double-bleeding earth! Hell-kite! It cannot be that hard, after all!
Sure! Alright! Come down, old sailor.
Well... wine makes one drunk! Huahaha! Harr harrrr!
I see... anyway: time to leave!
But it didn't bear any grapes at all!
What do ye demand? I'm merely a buccaneer. Witchcraft is none of my business! The grape of wine hast to be regarded as a symbol! Harr!
Well, it burns and doesn't harm anybody!
How dumb art you after all?

Imagine the following scenario: A lion gets the scent of the gold and tries to dig it out. If there were not the burning turtle, the gold would be lost. But this way, the lion will drop the gold because he wants to devour the turtle instead. But since the creature is litten in flames, he will have his maw terribly burned trying.
The result: The gold is safe. Thanks to the burning turtle!
Now I get it! Let's go.
Huh? Don't talk such a rubbish! Harrr!
The claw monkey curse was a pure deed of desparation! There just wasn't anything senseful comin' to me mind anymore!

Yes, indeed! And we shalt leave now! I still have two ears remaining, which is quite a lot in comparison to the average stock of mine other extremities! And this shalt stay that way. So stop babblin' plunder before they fall off, wilst ye!
I only wanted to dig out a treasure, and now this is where I am. Cruising with a pirate.
Now he has brought me to a different island, but I do not have the slightest clue what he expects me to do here!
This is where I plan my raids and repair my magnific ship, if it has been damaged in battle.

Well... actually, this is what I used to do. But some weeks ago, somebody came hither and ransacked and raided everything. They blew up my entire lighthouse! Arrr! Of course I was on a raid at that time and could not stop them, aye? I saw it when I returned. The fog was so dense that one could cut it in slices. I was doomed, because I didn't have any cuttery. Which was not the main problem; that was rather the missing lighthouse. With a big crush, I ran ashore with at least 10 knots of velocity. Hoho! I spotted my island by far too late. I expected that the lighthouse would warn me. Arrr...
Anyway, my ship is a complete wreck now. It is down there at the beach. I really am on a run of bad luck. I had not even yet got over the death of my parrot when it happened!
And what do you want me to do here?
I feel very sorry for you.
Harrr! Did ye not listen properly?! I am a dreadful pirate! A pirate without a ship!
Ye fool shalt help me! I need ye to build a new ship. Won't get far with the olde phantom rudder boat!
Alright, I see. It looks like I have no choice.
Hohoho. Thank ye for being so understanding! At least I have a new parrot now. All more that I need is a ship...
Um... what do I have to do with that?
Well... We could surely also solve our problem by rebuilding the lighthouse.
Then I could send light signals to the next inhabited island and they would send help hither - per ship.
Before ye can do anything here, ye must light all torches on the island. There is a pair of firestones in my cottage. If somebody might occasionally come across, he will see us better then.
Plus, I just like fire. This is why me jacket is red. Lovely, isn't it?
Um... yes, sure... I'm off to work on it.
Arrr! Ye hast not litten all torches yet!
There are two flintstones in mine cottage, in case ye do not have a pair.
Warm and illuminated! Hoho! That is how I like it!
Let's see... er... oh, right. Ye want to get away, don't ye?
Either ye help me to rebuild my lighthouse or we repair my ship.
It is up to thee to decide.
For the lighthouse I need 30 stones, for the ship 15 logs should do it.
Get the stuff and deliver it to me, then we will see how to carry on!
Hoho! Ye have nothing for me? Talk to me again when ye have trunks or stones! We will not get further otherwise.
I would do it meself, but I have just one leg, one hand and one eye left. Harharrr!! That does sum up to quite a handicap, I can tell ye!
Harrharr! Ye cannot decide, can ye? Ye brought both stones AND logs! I will get mixed up! Har har!
What luck is it that I have taken down exact notes!
If ye carry on like that ye might once become a real buccaneer, lad!
Har har! Oops! Ye broughtst me enough timber! It's unbelievable!
Ye may have a break now. Let's carry on tomorrow in the morning!
Har har! Oops! Ye broughtst me enough stones! It's unbelievable!
Hoho! Just have a nick first! Tomorrow we shalt carry on, lad.
When I slept, he must just have hopped into his phantom rudder boat and left. The jerk has imposed on my kindness! What a shameless boldness!
Over there, he seems to have left a message for me. I should take a look at it.
As I try to grab the message, suddenly I hear a loud cracking below me. The jetty breaks and the message falls down into the water that is filled to the very rim with sharks - and I follow it!
Now I must grab the message as quickly as possible and then get out of the water, or I can forget the whole survival thing.
This is what the pirate wrote:
Fair thea wal, yee dump lubber!
Thanx for al teh stuf, I kan youse it reely wel.
If ye want too ged awey too, ye musst ownlee use the stones att the ruins!
Une of themm is carsted with a telleport spall! It wil bring ye too a FRIEND!!
P.S.: Naver drust a pirrate!! Hohoho!!!
I am dumb. Indeed. But at least I have a better orthography than the chap. That is a little consolation.
I will see if what he wrote about the stones is true. I am breathless of anticipation! It is all so exciting!
A map with a strange text. Perhaps I might find something if I strictly stick to the instructions and dig at the target spot!
The shape of a kind of hat and used for washing
from there on to the southwest until you are surrounded by fern
Henceforth southwards you go till the element of beginning
Northeast is the direction to your hard goal
I have found the treasure! A watch and a gold nugget! Awesome!
Trying to have myself teleported by the rock, I notice lightning and thunder. At closer sight, I see an inscription that reveals important facts that the pirate appears to have kept secret from me:

This worthy teleport stone 2050 XL of the quality brand Neptune needs the power of the water in order to perform long-range teleport. Please place 25 children of the sea at the stone before you use it.
In case of problems, contact our technical customer service by dialing 0190 ...
... the rest is too weather-beaten to be made out. Hm.
I am feeling dizzy. A flash of light, and suddenly I am standing a different place. But it is unknown to me as well. I want to go home!
If you read this (and in case you have finally learned how to read), prepare to die soon. Except if you are here by ship - then you should bugger off as quickly as possible.

But if you have teleported yourself here, you can entirely forget it. You cannot get away. The 10 crystals that are required to teleport oneself away again are spread all over the island, and I can tell you for sure that they are well-guarded!
I had to leave the island for a magical conference, but as soon as I return, I will change you into a slimy snail, you stinking little thief!
I nevertheless wish you an agreeable stay on MY island.
Enjoy it as long as you can!
I have read a sign with a message that appears to be adressed to the pirate.
The chap who lives here surely is no friend. Apart from that, I have read something about 10 crystals. It seems like I need them to get off.

This island is teeming with raptors guarding the crystals. They are faster than a man, and with their sharp fangs and claws they can kill you within a few seconds! You are only safe if you flee into the water or climb somewhere where they cannot follow you.
I have found one of the crystals. Luckily they shine brightly. This should make it much easier to find the other nine ones in this darkness.
I have finally found all ten crytals, but what is to do now?
Consider how you have come to this island!
Oh no... apart from the fact that I of course didn't land at home by sheer luck, I am noticing that I appear to have lost all items during the teleport. Damn.
Arrows! The bleeding bastards are shooting at me!
Looks like a village inhabited by natives - and it is guarded by two watch towers. I better ought to keep some distance to them.
Me? Question rather what you do! But me not care.
Me trade with old man who give plants of joy.
Do you live in the village?
Yes. Old man with white beard. Live in tent at shore.
Yes, me home is village of tribe. Here we live.
Feel safe because safeguard of towers with bowmen.
I want to get into the village!
Towers with bowmen shoot at you if you go village!
I will just enter it, whatever you say.
Can't I do something about that?
You talk about brown mass come out bottom?
Is sanctuary of tribe. We call Pupu. Stranger worship it.
You need help from tribe or you never come onwards.
Tribe will not help if you stranger. You need me for come in village of tribe.
As punishment for dumbness me act like not know you.
Oh no... alright, in Devil's name...
Me can help become friend of tribe. Friend of tribe have free entry to village of tribe.
Towers with bowmen not shoot at friends, only shoot at foes.
I'll better terminate this, you queer oddball!
Sounds good. What shall I do?
You help me then me help you.
Then we both happy and drink cup o'tea.
We have find crate lie at beach.
I see... and what shall I do?
Me have lied. We not have tea.
We urine of turtles. Taste magnific.
Drink yummy cup urine when you be friend of tribe.
Me now tell you what must do.
If you me help me will say my tribe that you friend, not foe.
But first you must proof that you be true friend.
Me give you list of tasks.
Then I shall start to work!
The list that the native gave me:
20 feathers - for new arrows of bowmen
When you have ALL together, you me search and give me!
Fantastic! You have all get for me! Now it can go on.
When I come across next time in village I bring tidings that you new friend for tribe.
You then come into village. But not before. Or towers with bowmen shoot.
Hello stranger on path to friend!
You not have all from list I have give you. Only talk again to me when have all on list with you.
I must trade. Not like to talk to you anymore.
How are you? Have you stranded here too?
That is already some years ago. But I don't try to get away anymore since quite a while. This Island is located just about in the middle of nowhere. It seems like there's nothing around.
You wouldn't stand any chance without a real ship.

But I have come to an arrangement! I just set up my tent, and now I grow my weed here. The natives are totally crazy about the shit! I channel them some of it off. In exchange, they give me everything I need.
What? You haven't got to know them yet?

You can call yourself lucky! They are quite... um, well ... let's say precautious towards strangers. Their village is guarded by two watch towers. They shoot on everybody they don't know. When I was there for the first time, they'd nearly have killed me, son!
By now, they know me and don't attack me anymore. That would be pretty stupid, because they wouldn't get their joints anymore.
That's odd. A stranded Hippie Grandpa that grows hemp, rolls joints and hucksters them to the natives.
Anyway, the chap seems to know the ropes. I should let him show them to me.
What can I do for ya, fellow?
Oh... green elephants. They're everywhere. Watch out!
D'you also find cows totally super?
Why do your eyes glow yellow and pink?
I wonder where I can get new sandals...
How can I get into the village?
Yes, everything's alright with me. I feel fine. Good vibes 'n' stuff.

In all the time I've been here, I have gathered quite a lot of useful experience. Of course I'm open to share it with you. But I demand your service in return; you have to harvest hemp for me and pile it up in my storage.
You only gotta blow upon the hemp plant per [$key_attack1] until it falls over. The leaves remain on the ground. You can simply pick them up with [$key_use].
If you want to grow new hemp plants on yourself, you just gotta take the leaves into your hand.

Then you search for a free spot at the ground. Look onto the spot and press [$key_use] to plant a new hemp plant. Let it grow for some days until you reap it again to gain a higher number of hemp leaves.
I'm afraid you haven't reaped enough hemp for that.
Harvest the listed amount and put it into my storage!
Baking bread is a craft of its own. It takes a lot of work, but you will see it's worth all of it.

First among, you need grain. You can harvest it by pounding against it per [$key_attack1]. That way, you get sheaves of crop that you must use in the inventory to get the grains out. The grains can instantly be eaten, which does not make much sense. It's better to grind them or to seed them again.
To seed them, just take them into the hand and look at a free spot on the ground. Press [$key_use] to place them there. Some days later, you can reap the crop.

If you want to grind the grains to make flour out of them, you need at least 9 units of grain to combine them with a stone. The flour is edible as well, but you actually shouldn't do that, because it makes you damn thirsty.
Go to a fountain or to a well and use the flour there to knead it to paste with the water.

The paste is already quite good to satisfy one's hunger. If you don't have fire at hand, you can just eat it raw. But if it's possible to bake the paste, you should always do that. Just go to a campfire and use the paste to bake it and obtain bread.
Bread is the best kind of food that you can make on yourself out here. It satisfies even very great hunger.
If you run short of food, fishing often turns out to be the solution.
It is needless to say that you need a fishing rod to get started.

Combine a branch with water or use it at a wellspring to make it bendable. You can't use sea water for this! The bendable branch is your rod - you only need a fishing line for the completion. Use wool to spin thread out of it and combine it with the bendable branch. Voila, your fishing rod is ready.
Then all that's left to do is take the rod in your hand and angle via [$key_attack2].
You can fish at any shore you find, but there are not fishes everywhere. There are two ways to spot  fishes:
- Diving: If the water is deep enough, you can just dive into the water and have a look with your own eyes if there are fishes around.
- Bubbles: If bubbles rise in the water and spread as concentric waves at the surface, you can also fish successfully at the particular place. Even if you don't see fishes when you dive in!
So choose the spot where you fish wisely, son.

By the way: fishing also increases your fishing skill. This improves your chances for a good gain. Moreover, you can unlock the bow net that way. That's a kind of net trap that can be set up in the water catch fish.
The art of healing is very important. If you don't cure your wounds correctly, you can die faster than you can imagine.

When you sustain a fracture, you are strongly handicapped and an easy prey for the creatures of wilderness. But you can quite simply help yourself by splinting the fracture. You only need a stick and a long vine. Combine both and tie the branch to the broken bone with the vine. The splinting makes the two parts heal quicklier and allows you to stress them stronglier.

Deep wounds can cause bleedings that do not heal on themselves. In such a case, you must react quickly and combine a vine with a leaf. Lay the leaf onto the wound and fix it to it with the vine. Pay attention to give the leaf enough pressure.
The golden herb is an efficient means against dizziness. It is easily recognisable by its light yellow colour. It's a real shame that it's so seldom. You must simply eat it to let it affect you.

The bitter root is a plain, dark root that can often be found in the shadow, near to bushes and trees. As its name implies, it has a very bitter taste. If you consume it, you will instantly vomit the whole content of your guts out, including the toxic substances that are making you high, drunk or whichever kind of inebriated.
There are several ways to brew a health potion. See some of my recipes:
Pound the healing herb with the stone and mix the juice with water
Same procedure. You need three normal healing herbs, because their power is weaker than that of a strong healing herb.

If you have a lot of golden herbs, this is an alternate way instead of the classical health potion with healing herbs. Separate the golden cusps from the rest of the golden herb, pulverise them and mix them with water. The healing power of the golden herb sadly is quite restricted, which makes the hight amount necessary.
Health potions regenerate one's health with the time and are good against intoxications, dizziness and inebriation.
You want to know how to get into the village, son... hahaha...
I can tell you: You have to learn the language of the natives!
I can teach it to you, but that'll be a shitload of work.
If you help me with the harvest and take care that there are at least 30 leaves of hemp in my storage, I will give you lessons.
Okay... Then I'll better go and do that...
There must be 30 leaves of hemp in my storage. Do me that little favour and I'll teach you what you want.
Yes - I am always open to a fair trade.
I can offer you health potions, juice and cookies.
I want to be paid in branches, so that I can fence my plantation.
Here, take the cookie! And thanks for the branches.
I can't leave it to you.
You must have at least 5 branches for it!
Yummy juice for you and strong wood for me.
You must have at least 15 branches for it!
You must have at least 35 branches for it!
The hemp grandfather has offered me to teach me the language of the natives, to make myself understood and get into their village.
Before the lessons start, I must lend him a hand for the harvest of his weed.
I must increase his stock to at least 30 leaves.
It looks like the lessons can begin now...

I have got the green stuff for the chappy, and he has been true to his word. He gave me a crash course about the language these strange natives speak, and I now feel able to make myself understood in their tongue. The problem is only that a rain of arrows crackles down upon me every time I approach their village. I must find one of them outside the village!
Hugh harrr Tschack! Gnar gnar! Ignak!
A trespassing illegal immigrant! Go away! Burrrrn!
Hello. Me ear got news that you now friend of tribe. You be welcome in ours circle.
Name is Rootignoot. Me be mighty chieftain of tribe with scary mask full of colourful paint and with strong magical powers!
Me can make things burn with me magic.
But what with you? Why you here?
Me understand. Me believe, you not want stay here?

Here you will learn how to play Stranded 2 and how to survive in wilderness.
Move the mouse to look around.
You can move by holding down the following buttons:
If you want to find out how Stranded 2 works and what you have to do to survive, just follow the path and read the signs. At the various stations, you will be taught everything that you need to know.

To use something on the island (i.e. to read a sign), you have to look at it by pointing the cursor on it. Pressing down a button will trigger an action. But keep in mind: Only some certain objects will react if you use them that way.
Follow the path and read the signs!
Water surrounds the island, but can also be found in the form of ponds and puddles.

Water can be used just like other objects! Look on the surface and press [$key_use]. If you are lucky, it will be fresh water that satisfies your thirst. But in most cases, you will only find salt water, which will only increase your thirst when you drink it.

Your thirst is displayed on the top left corner in the form of a blue bar. The broader the blue bar is, the higher is your thirst. If the bar is entirely full, you will lose health until you do something against your thirst. The health is shown in the very top bar.
In the character menu, you can have a closer look at the values on the left top.
Of course you can close the menu again by clicking the buttons. As long as it is open, the game will be paused.
You can hit many objects in the world of Stranded in order to gain items.
To strike upon something, you must look at it by pointing at it with the mouse. A left-click will then trigger a stroke.
You only use your hands as long as you do not select something to hold in them. On the right bottom corner, you see if - or what - you are holding in your hand. Details will follow later.

If you often hit objects such as trees, you will get items that are instantly stored in your rucksack (in case you are not carrying too much already). If and how many items you get per hit is decided per random. However, not all objects provide items and furthermore, you will gain far more from some certain objects, if you use the right tool.
If you have items, you will of course be able to do something with them. To do so, you must look into your rucksack.
Click an item in the rucksack to select it (another click will deselect it). Now you can use the item by clicking the use-button (see tooltip).
Keep in mind, that not all items can be used that way.
Eating items works the same way - with the slight difference, that you have to use the eat button.
Of course, you cannot eat anything.
To take items into your hand, you can proceed just like for eating or using them - but you have to use the hand button for this.
You can also assign numeric keys to items. If you press the fitting button in the game, you immediately hold the item in your hand without having to open the rucksack - handy thing.
Select an item and press a numeric key [1-9] to assign it to the item. If you want to delete the assignment, choose the item again and press the same key.
To chuck things away, select an item and press the drop button. If you have many items of the same type, you can choose wether to drop just one, the half, or all of them.

To combine items, you have to select at least 2 different ones and click the combine button. Depending on the particular combination, it may also happen that nothing happens, or that a combination submenu appears that lists various possible combinations. For some combinations, you need more than one item per type. If you do not have enough, the menu will nevertheless appear, but red numbers will show you what you need.
An obstacle! You could of course just go around it, but sometimes it is better to jump over it!
When you jump, you can influence your direction with the movement keys.
But keep in mind that jumping is exhausting and increases hunger, thirst and fatigue quickly.

Apropos: Besides the thirst that was already mentioned, there are also hunger and fatigue. All these values are raised by movement. You must eat, drink and sleep to keep them as low as possible. Otherwise, the resulting loss of health may lead to your death!
Hunger is illustrated by a green bar on the top left corner and in the character menu, whereas fatigue is the violet one.

You can only sleep ashore, and only if you are tired enough and there are no dangerous animals close to you. If you do not sleep in a building or cave, the sleep will cost you a bit of energy. Hunger and thirst will be increased as well.
Use the sleep button in the character menu or the sleep key to sleep.
Weapons! They can be made with certain combinations.
If you take them into your hand, you can hunt or defend yourself.
Meelee weapons such as the machete work just like simple striking with your fists. The only difference is that you deal more damage with them.
Spears can be thrown via [$key_attack1]. Once thrown, they are gone. So you have to aim carefully and keep in mind that they do not fly straightly but are influenced by gravity.

There are also weapons that are not thrown themselves but which need ammunition. Bows, for instance, or the slingshot. The ammunition is displayed on the right bottom corner, directly on the right of the weapon itself. If there are several types of ammunition in your inventory that fit for the same weapon, you can switch between them.
There is a whole lot of tools lying around here. They can be made by combining raw materials.
Many tools can either be used as a weapon or peacefully as a tool. If we have such a case, then this is how to handle the dual use:

This probably is the most important tool at all. By its tool function, you can set up building sites where there is free room, or work on the building sites consuming the required materials. Constructing buildings often unlocks new ones in the construction menu.

It allows you to pull fishes out of the water. The more often you fish, the better your fishing skills will become. You can see the skills - if yet achieved - in the character menu. A click on a skill leads to additional information. When you fish, pay attention to fishing areas. You will see bubbles rising and waves spreading in circles where there is a big swarm of fishes.

Apart from the fishring rod, there are many other tools. The axe, for example, makes very high damage on wood. The pickaxe, in return, can extract metals more easily from certain rocks. With the shovel, you can dig out things and the net serves as a device to catch insects. A torch lightens the environment at night and the scythe is useful for harvesting crop.
A source of sprinkling water is an endless supply of fresh water. Here, you can drink by clicking [$key_use].
Hollow stones save water when it rains and you can only drink from them a few times until they are empty.
Fruits grow only at certain plants. You can pluck and eat them. But watch out: it normally takes several days until new ones have grown.
You can pluck fruits by simple using:
If they hang too high, you can also shoot them down with ranged weapons from trees or palms and pick them up afterwards.
Fruits can also be planted in order to gain more of them. For some, you need good skills in agriculture. These can be increased by just planting other things.
For planting, take the fruits into your hand, point at the ground and use it by pressing [$key_use].
Some plants have to be completely destroyed to gain items. For example, crop and hemp are such cases. Both can be planted just like fruits.
Keep in mind that plants regenerate slowly (overnight). So if you do not want to destroy plants, but only gain items by hitting them, you should give them some days in order to let them regenerate.
